messages:
maya: Thinking out loud — propose a small change: auto-generate deploy scripts and preflight checks per service. Idea is a single command that emits a vetted script + changewindow checks so on-call can run quick dry-runs.
jon: +1. We get a lot of ad-hoc deploy steps in PRs. Templates would cut mistakes.
alex: Do you mean a generator that outputs a bash file + a release-note stub?
maya: Exactly. Example flow: `ri deploy-gen service=webapp env=staging --window=22:00-02:00` -> creates `deploy-webapp-staging.sh` with preflight checks, required flags, and a release notes template.
sam: Important: generator should validate change window against calendar (no overlaps with infra maintenance) and surface conflicts. Also include a `--force-window` if ops owner approves.
jon: For safety, default to `--dry-run` mode. Maybe output also a deploy-bot command you can paste: `/deploy webapp --image sha:abcd1234 --canary 10 --dry-run`
maya: Draft of the generated preflight snippet we could include in the script:```#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# preflight: check DB migrations, quiesce traffic, verify quota
./scripts/check-db-migrations.sh || { echo "migrations failed"; exit 1; }
./scripts/ensure-no-long-requests.sh || { echo "active requests"; exit 1; }
# call deploy-bot for canary
# /deploy --service webapp --image $IMAGE --canary 10 --pin $PIN
```
alex: We should also auto-fill a release note stub in Markdown:```- change: bump webapp to $IMAGE
- reason: hotfix for x
- rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m
- rollback-plan: revert to $PREV_IMAGE with ip-reproxy and traffic-shift
```
maya: + include a machine-readable metadata header in the script for tooling to parse (service, image, pin, window). That enables dashboards to show upcoming deploys.
sam: On rollbacks: generator should emit a `rollback.sh` with the exact `pin`/`image` to use and a one-line deploy-bot command, e.g. `/deploy webapp --image sha:prev123 --pin prev-20260301 --force`. Keep it idempotent.
deploy-bot: dry-run OK — simulated canary steps, estimated token cost: low, checks passed: db-migration-check, quota-check. Use `/deploy --confirm` to execute. :white_check_mark:
jon: Nice — can we add a linter for generated scripts so reviewers can quickly approve? Small CLI `ri-deploy-lint` that verifies metadata and checks for `--dry-run` by default.
maya: Plan: I'll prototype generator using our existing templates and open a PR with 3 examples (webapp, api-gateway, worker). If people like it we add the lint and changewindow-calendar integration. Any objections?
alex: No objections. Suggest adding a flag `--skip-release-notes` for tiny patches.
sam: Also add audit log integration: annotate generated metadata with requestor and PR number so audits link back.
maya: Great — I'll put a short RFC in the repo and tag you all. Thanks! :rocket:
